question: For the subnet with ID `012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48` (IPv4 only) and considering only routes whose next hop is `10.30.19.197/8`, return the subnet name along with (1) the range and variance of allocation-pool starting IPs (FIRST_IP) across its IP allocation pools and (2) the dense-rank of its associated standard attribute when ordered by the standard attribute UPDATED_AT timestamp using a window frame of the current row and the 2 preceding rows, plus the subnet’s tenant ID and the average FIRST_IP range across all subnets that have routes with next hop `10.30.19.197/8`. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH target_subnet AS (
    SELECT s.id, s.name, s.tenant_id, s.standard_attr_id
    FROM subnets s
    WHERE s.id = '012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48'
      AND s.ip_version = 4
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM subnetroutes sr
          WHERE sr.subnet_id = s.id
            AND sr.nexthop = '10.30.19.197/8'
      )
),
subnet_pools AS (
    SELECT p.first_ip
    FROM ipallocationpools p
    JOIN target_subnet ts ON p.subnet_id = ts.id
),
pool_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        MAX(first_ip) - MIN(first_ip) AS first_ip_range,
        VARIANCE(first_ip) AS first_ip_variance
    FROM subnet_pools
),
std_attr_rank AS (
    SELECT DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sa.updated_at ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS dense_rank
    FROM standardattributes sa
    JOIN target_subnet ts ON sa.id = ts.standard_attr_id
),
all_subnet_ranges AS (
    SELECT 
        s.id AS subnet_id,
        MAX(p.first_ip) - MIN(p.first_ip) AS first_ip_range
    FROM subnets s
    JOIN ipallocationpools p ON s.id = p.subnet_id
    JOIN subnetroutes sr ON s.id = sr.subnet_id AND sr.nexthop = '10.30.19.197/8'
    GROUP BY s.id
),
avg_range_stats AS (
    SELECT AVG(first_ip_range) AS avg_first_ip_range
    FROM all_subnet_ranges
)
SELECT 
    ts.name AS subnet_name,
    ps.first_ip_range,
    ps.first_ip_variance,
    sar.dense_rank,
    ts.tenant_id,
    ars.avg_first_ip_range
FROM target_subnet ts
CROSS JOIN pool_stats ps
CROSS JOIN std_attr_rank sar
CROSS JOIN avg_range_stats ars;

WITH target_subnet AS (
    SELECT s.id, s.name, s.tenant_id, s.standard_attr_id
    FROM subnets s
    WHERE s.id = '012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48'
      AND s.ip_version = 4
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM subnetroutes sr
          WHERE sr.subnet_id = s.id
            AND sr.nexthop = '10.30.19.197/8'
      )
),
subnet_pools AS (
    SELECT p.first_ip
    FROM ipallocationpools p
    JOIN target_subnet ts ON p.subnet_id = ts.id
),
pool_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        MAX(first_ip) - MIN(first_ip) AS first_ip_range,
        VARIANCE(first_ip) AS first_ip_variance
    FROM subnet_pools
),
std_attr_rank AS (
    SELECT DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sa.updated_at ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS dense_rank
    FROM standardattributes sa
    JOIN target_subnet ts ON sa.id = ts.standard_attr_id
),
all_subnet_ranges AS (
    SELECT 
        s.id AS subnet_id,
        MAX(p.first_ip) - MIN(p.first_ip) AS first_ip_range
    FROM subnets s
    JOIN ipallocationpools p ON s.id = p.subnet_id
    JOIN subnetroutes sr ON s.id = sr.subnet_id AND sr.nexthop = '10.30.19.197/8'
    GROUP BY s.id
),
avg_range_stats AS (
    SELECT AVG(first_ip_range) AS avg_first_ip_range
    FROM all_subnet_ranges
)
SELECT 
    ts.name AS subnet_name,
    ps.first_ip_range,
    ps.first_ip_variance,
    sar.dense_rank,
    ts.tenant_id,
    ars.avg_first_ip_range
FROM target_subnet ts
CROSS JOIN pool_stats ps
CROSS JOIN std_attr_rank sar
CROSS JOIN avg_range_stats ars;
